experiment: free-running candidate DAC latch phase on fixed joint mask04 transmit map

fixture.capture: one free-running latch edge per 1500 microinstructions
fixture.clock_hypothesis: 9600 Hz if one 14.4 MHz oscillator period per microinstruction

limitations: The free-running clock, microinstruction period, Y-to-latch data bus, DAC08 bus, analog filter and physical line route are untraced.
All six bus orders share Y7-to-DAC MSB, so repeated MSB-only scores are not independent streams.
A decoder accepting several phases cannot identify the actual latch clock from this test alone.
